description: 20-question RAG evaluation dataset covering Regolo plans, PAYG pricing, Zero Data Retention, and Langfuse EU observability (October 2026).

items.question: What is the daily token limit on the Regolo Core plan?
items.context: The Regolo Core subscription costs 39.00 euro per month (discounted by 70% to 11.70 euro/month for the first 3 months) and includes up to 600 million tokens per month with a daily cap of 20 million tokens per day.

items.question: How many monthly tokens are included in the Regolo Core subscription?
items.context: The Regolo Core subscription costs 39.00 euro per month and includes a monthly pool of up to 600 million tokens across all included Core chat models.

items.question: What is the promotional monthly price of the Regolo Core plan during the first 3 months?
items.context: Regolo offers a 70% introductory discount on the Core subscription for the first 3 months, bringing the monthly price from 39.00 euro down to 11.70 euro per month.

items.question: What are the Pay-As-You-Go input and output prices per 1M tokens for Gemma 4 31B on Regolo?
items.context: On Regolo Pay-As-You-Go (October 2026), Gemma 4 31B (model slug gemma4-31b) costs 0.40 euro per 1 million input tokens and 2.10 euro per 1 million output tokens.

items.question: What is the Pay-As-You-Go input price per 1M tokens for Qwen 3.8 27B on Regolo?
items.context: On Regolo Pay-As-You-Go (October 2026), Qwen 3.8 27B (model slug qwen3.8-27b) is priced at 0.50 euro per 1 million input tokens and 2.10 euro per 1 million output tokens.

items.question: What is the Pay-As-You-Go output price per 1M tokens for GLM 5.2 on Regolo?
items.context: On Regolo Pay-As-You-Go (October 2026), GLM 5.2 (model slug glm5.2) costs 2.00 euro per 1 million input tokens and 5.20 euro per 1 million output tokens.

items.question: How much does a 700-token RAG evaluation turn (500 input + 200 output tokens) cost on Gemma 4 31B under Regolo PAYG?
items.context: A standard RAG evaluation turn with 500 input tokens and 200 output tokens (700 tokens total) costs 0.00062 euro on Gemma 4 31B, 0.00067 euro on Qwen 3.8 27B, and 0.00204 euro on GLM 5.2 under Regolo PAYG.

items.question: What is the effective cost of a 700-token evaluation turn at full utilization on the standard 39 euro/month Regolo Core plan?
items.context: At full utilization of the 600M token monthly pool on the 39.00 euro/month Regolo Core subscription (0.065 euro per 1M tokens), a 700-token evaluation turn costs 0.000045 euro.

items.question: How many average output tokens per task does GLM 5.2 generate on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index?
items.context: According to Artificial Analysis (June 2026), GLM 5.2 leads open-weight models on the Intelligence Index at $0.46 per task, generating an average of 43,000 output tokens per task, of which 37,000 are hidden reasoning tokens.

items.question: How many total output tokens does Gemma 4 31B generate across the full Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index suite?
items.context: Gemma 4 31B generates 39 million output tokens across the full Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index evaluation suite (April 2026), making it a concise choice for RAG and LLM-as-a-judge scoring.

items.question: Does Regolo store or reuse customer prompts and completions for model training?
items.context: Regolo operates in certified European green datacenters under certified Zero Data Retention (ZDR): customer prompts and completions are never stored on disk and never reused for training.

items.question: What is the OpenAI-compatible base URL for calling models on Regolo?
items.context: To route OpenAI SDK or Langfuse OpenAI wrapper calls to Regolo's European datacenters, set base_url to https://api.regolo.ai/v1 and pass your REGOLO_API_KEY.

items.question: Which embedding model on Regolo is priced at 0.001 euro per request on Pay-As-You-Go?
items.context: Regolo serves Qwen3-Embedding-8B for document and code retrieval at 0.001 euro per request on Pay-As-You-Go alongside Qwen3-Reranker-4B.

items.question: Under which open-source license is the core Langfuse observability platform released?
items.context: Langfuse is an MIT-licensed open-source LLM observability and evaluation platform that can be self-hosted via Docker or Kubernetes on your own EU servers or used via its Frankfurt EU cloud region.

items.question: What is the execution time limit for deterministic code evaluators running inside Langfuse?
items.context: Langfuse executes deterministic Python and TypeScript code evaluators directly in the platform within a 2-second execution limit and without external network access.

items.question: What production sampling rate does the guide recommend for online LLM-as-a-judge evaluators in Langfuse?
items.context: Run deterministic code evaluators on 100% of live observations for free, and configure your online LLM-as-a-judge evaluator in Langfuse to sample 5% of production observations.

items.question: On what date does Langfuse sunset legacy trace-level judges in favor of observation-level evaluators?
items.context: Attach online judges directly to the root observation of your RAG workflow because Langfuse sunsets legacy trace-level judges on November 16, 2026.

items.question: What minimum faithfulness threshold is used in the CI pull-request gate example?
items.context: When a teammate edits the RAG prompt or swaps the model slug in a pull request, the GitHub Actions CI pipeline blocks the merge and raises a RegressionError if average faithfulness drops below 0.85.

items.question: What is the monthly token allowance and daily limit on the Regolo Boost plan (89 euro/month)?
items.context: For multi-step agents in CI and production, the Regolo Boost plan costs 89 euro/month and includes up to 1.5 billion tokens per month with a limit of 50 million tokens per day.

items.question: How many monthly tokens are included in the Regolo Scale plan at 319 euro/month?
items.context: For heavy enterprise R&D reasoning workloads, the Regolo Pro plan costs 169 euro/month (3B tokens/month) and the Scale plan costs 319 euro/month (6B tokens/month).
